data.name: Purge Of Evil: Age of the Fallen Spirits
data.detailed_description:
Long ago, the balance between the living world and the spirit realm was broken.

In a land shaped by ancient mountains, sacred rivers, and forgotten villages, malevolent spirits now roam freely. Myths once whispered by elders have become living nightmares. Beneath floods, forests, and ruined shrines, something ancient is awakening.

You play as a lone warrior chosen by fate, wielding steel and will against beings born from Vietnamese folklore. As you journey through cursed lands, you will uncover fragmented truths, confront fallen gods, and face spirits bound by hatred, sorrow, and unfinished vows.

This is not a tale of heroes and villains.

It is a story of karma, sacrifice, and the price of survival.

⸻

⚔️ KEY FEATURES

🔥 Combat Rooted in Skill-Based Swordplay

Engage in fast, deliberate combat focused on timing, positioning, and precision. Master dodges, counters, and carefully timed strikes to overcome supernatural foes.

🌑 A World Inspired by Vietnamese Mythology

Encounter spirits and deities drawn from Vietnamese folklore and legends, including river ghosts, forest demons, forgotten gods, and corrupted guardians shaped by centuries of belief.

🧩 Mystery-Driven Exploration

Uncover the truth behind cursed villages and haunted lands through environmental storytelling, puzzles, and subtle clues left behind by the dead.

🌿 Living Legends, Broken Lands

Explore diverse environments inspired by Vietnam’s natural and spiritual landscapes: flooded villages, mist-covered forests, ancient temples, and sacred mountains scarred by divine conflict.

🕯️ Choice, Consequence, and Karma

Your actions affect the world around you. Protect the innocent, uncover hidden truths, or walk a darker path as karma silently shapes your fate.

🎵 Atmosphere Above All

Experience a haunting world brought to life with ambient soundscapes, traditional-inspired motifs, and minimal UI designed to keep you immersed.
